subject: FY22 School Operating Budget Request
overview: The School Committee held its final public hearing on the Superintendent's recommended Fiscal Year 2022 operating budget. The committee voted to request $68,221,865 from the municipal government to support school operations and pandemic-recovery initiatives.

items.title: Superintendent's Budget Presentation
items.summary: David Murphy presented an overview of the $68.2 million operating budget request, which includes a $3.1 million increase in fixed costs driven primarily by special education and transportation. The request reflects 'authentic needs' for literacy and math support, while approximately $1 million in infrastructure items were shifted to the capital budget.

items.title: Transportation Equity and High School Bus Fees
items.summary: The committee discussed a mandate to provide free, reliable yellow bus transportation for all high school students living outside a two-mile radius to replace reliance on MBTA passes. Murphy stated that while a plan is in development, the administration needs more data from the bus vendor and police to ensure the transition is fiscally responsible.

items.title: Staffing, Curriculum, and Capital Projects
items.summary: Members questioned the status of 'TBD' items, literacy and math coaching positions, and structural changes to library and technology staffing. Murphy clarified that major repairs for generators and boilers would be funded through capital requests rather than the operating budget.

items.title: Special Education and Grant Reconciliation
items.summary: The committee reviewed the allocation of paraprofessionals for inclusive settings and the Roberts School's new substantially separate program. Murphy agreed to establish a quarterly reconciliation process for external special education funding like Circuit Breaker and IDEA grants.

items.title: Public Comment on High School Transportation
items.summary: A resident voiced concerns regarding the unreliability of the MBTA for high school students and urged the administration to prioritize yellow bus expansion for equity. The administration established a target date of August 1st to provide a final transportation plan for the upcoming school year.

items.title: Student User Fees
items.summary: The committee noted a letter from students requesting the elimination of user fees for athletics and extracurricular activities, which currently generate between $75,000 and $95,000 annually.

items.title: Approval of FY22 Budget Request
items.summary: Approved the Fiscal Year 2022 operating budget request of $68,221,865.
